mapper.select: select DISTINCT t.id as templateId, t.template_name, t.alarm_type_value, t.template_status, t.creator, t.create_time, t.modifier, t.update_time, t.valid_start_date, t.valid_end_date, t.valid_start_time, t.valid_end_time, t.template_json, (select count(distinct (r.id)) from vm_radar_alarm_template_region_rel r where r.template_id = t.id) as unionRegionCount, s.type_name as alarmTypeName, t.task_id from vm_radar_alarm_template t left join sys_alarm_type s on t.alarm_type_value = s.type_value where t.delete_flag = '0' and s.delete_flag = '0' and t.id = #{param.templateId}

select a.id as regionId, a.region_name, a.region_type, a.region_json from vm_radar_alarm_template_region_rel r left join vm_radar_alarm_region a on r.region_id = a.id and r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and r.industry_code = a.industry_code where r.template_id = #{templateId}
